sql.sql: SELECT "c"."active" AS "active", "c"."code" AS "code", "c"."concept_id" AS "concept_id", "c"."definition" AS "definition", "c"."display" AS "display" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "r"."source_concept_id" AS "concept_id" FROM (SELECT * FROM "concept_link" "l" INNER JOIN "concept" "src" ON ("src"."concept_id" = "l"."source_concept_id") INNER JOIN "concept" "tgt" ON ("tgt"."concept_id" = "l"."target_concept_id") WHERE (("l"."property_id" = @prop_id_1) AND ("l"."edge_set_id" = @edge_set_id_2) AND ("l"."active" = 1) AND ("src"."cs_id" = @link_cs_id_3) AND ("tgt"."code" COLLATE NOCASE IN (@prop_value_0) OR "tgt"."display" COLLATE NOCASE IN (@prop_value_0)))) "r" WHERE ("r"."source_concept_id" IS NOT NULL) INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT "r"."source_concept_id" AS "concept_id" FROM (SELECT * FROM "concept_literal" "cl" INNER JOIN "concept" "src" ON ("src"."concept_id" = "cl"."source_concept_id") WHERE (("cl"."property_id" = @prop_id_4) AND ("cl"."active" = 1) AND ("src"."cs_id" = @literal_cs_id_5) AND ("cl"."value_text" COLLATE NOCASE IN (@prop_value_6) OR (("cl"."value_text" IS NULL) AND "cl"."value_raw" COLLATE NOCASE IN (@prop_value_6))))) "r" WHERE ("r"."source_concept_id" IS NOT NULL)) "m" INNER JOIN "concept" "c" ON ("c"."concept_id" = "m"."concept_id") WHERE ("c"."active" = 1) ORDER BY "c"."code" ASC LIMIT 100
